title: Phase 2：證明 OEIS A118109、A265225（規則 54 單細胞各列）的猜想公式

A118109-formulas.proof: Lean (core only) for all n: row closed form row_eq; a(n+2) = 10000*a(n) + (1 or 111); Barker recurrence a118109_rec, Keller floor formula a118109_floor. G.f. follows from the recurrence and initial terms (paper). Numeric: two methods in one script for n <= 300 plus DATA.

A265225-formulas.proof: Lean (core only) for all n: a265225_barker, a265225_rec, a265225_hurt, a265225_veselovac. G.f. from the recurrence (paper).

A265225-ianakiev.proof: Paper proof: n-subsets of 1..2n realise every sum in [n(n+1)/2, n(3n+1)/2]; minimum divisible by n is n(n+1)/2 (n odd) or n(n+2)/2 (n even) = a(n-1). The comment's 'a(n)' is off by one. Brute force n <= 11.

novelty.note: Exercise level: the row pattern is visible in NKS p.55 and A118108 already states the decimal closed form. Nothing new is claimed; the value is closing the conjecture labels in OEIS with checked proofs and correcting the index in Ianakiev's comment.
